title.en: MiniMax Releases H3 33B Video Model and Publishes Base Weights
title.zhHans: MiniMax 发布 330 亿参数 H3 视频生成模型并开放基础权重

searchSummary.en: MiniMax released H3, a 33B parameter video model featuring unified audio-visual modeling, publishing open weights under a geographically restricted community license.
searchSummary.zhHans: MiniMax 发布 330 亿参数音视频联合建模视频模型 H3，并在附带特定地域限制的社区许可下开放基础权重。

summary.en: On August 3, 2026, MiniMax published weights for H3-Base on Hugging Face under the MiniMax H3 Community License (dated August 2), following an initial July 31 API launch. The 33-billion parameter transformer model features native audio-visual co-encoding, with its community license restricting direct use in the US, UK, EU, and South Korea.
summary.zhHans: 在 7 月 31 日上线 API 后，MiniMax 于 2026 年 8 月 3 日在 Hugging Face 上正式开放 H3-Base 权重（社区许可证签署日期为 8 月 2 日）。该 330 亿参数 Transformer 模型具备原生音视频联合编码能力，其社区许可证限制在美、英、欧、韩等排除地域直接使用。

narrative.en: MiniMax launched H3, a 33-billion parameter multi-modal video generation system composed of an audio-visual base model, a contextual reasoning prompt engine (Context-IR), and a 2K resolution upscaler. By modeling voice, music, and sound effects inside a single encoder alongside video frames, H3 achieved top placement on independent video editing and generation benchmarks. The August 3 weights release on Hugging Face made H3-Base downloadable under a community license barring distillation and requiring formal authorization for deployment within excluded territories (US, EU, UK, South Korea).
narrative.zhHans: MiniMax 推出 330 亿参数的多模态视频生成系统 H3，由音视频基础模型、上下文推理提示词引擎（Context-IR）和 2K 分辨率放大器组成。通过在单一编码器中将语音、音乐、音效与视频帧联合建模，H3 在独立视频编辑与生成评测中位列前茅。8 月 3 日在 Hugging Face 开放的 H3-Base 权重遵循社区许可协议，禁止模型蒸馏并要求在美、英、欧、韩等指定排除地域使用时单独申请许可。

description.en: Provides state-of-the-art open-weight video generation with native audio synthesis at low inference costs under a restricted community license.
description.zhHans: 在受限社区许可下以较低推理成本提供了具备原生音频合成能力的高质量开源权重视频生成模型。

text.en: MiniMax published H3-Base weights on Hugging Face on August 3, 2026, under a Community License dated August 2, 2026.
text.zhHans: MiniMax 于 2026 年 8 月 3 日在 Hugging Face 上开放 H3-Base 权重，其社区许可证标注日期为 2026 年 8 月 2 日。

text.en: The H3 weights license prohibits distillation and designates the US, UK, EU, and South Korea as excluded territories requiring formal application for use.
text.zhHans: H3 权重许可证禁止模型蒸馏，并将美、英、欧、韩列为排除地域，使用需单独提交正式申请。

text.en: Ranked first on Artificial Analysis video editing benchmarks, demonstrating competitive 2K video generation quality comparable to proprietary commercial models.
text.zhHans: 在 Artificial Analysis 视频编辑评测中位列第一，展现出可比肩专有商业模型的 2K 视频生成质量。

text.en: Context-IR and 2K regeneration modules remain proprietary, and territorial license restrictions limit unconditional global deployment.
text.zhHans: Context-IR 与 2K 放大模块仍属专有，且地域许可限制约束了无条件的全球自由部署。

editorial.reviewNotes: Published after The Batch newsletter analysis and weights release confirmation. Reviewed 2026-08-24 after the latest-30 evidence, calibration, and language audit.

changeLog.summary: Corrected event date from August 13 placeholder to August 3 (weights release date; license dated August 2), updated sources to repository URL and Runpod independent coverage, removing 404 The Batch source.
